description.value: Originally Gaia Grocery and now rebranded as Neighbours Café + Provisions under new ownership, this community hub at 150 Fourth St in Tofino combines a full grocery store with a specialty espresso café serving beans from Tofino Coffee Roasting Company. The store emphasises locally sourced products and affordable pricing, and also carries Cocofino dairy-free frozen yogurt made by the owners. It bills itself as a community gathering place where anyone passing through Tofino — resident or visitor — is treated as a neighbour.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 19m; stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (4 spaces) at 76m; stands (6 spaces) at 77m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gaiagrocery.ca loads successfully but reveals a complete rebrand: Gaia Grocery has been taken over by new owners (Kevin and Marie) and relaunched as 'Neighbours Café + Provisions,' operating at the same 150 Fourth St address in Tofino. The about page explicitly names Gaia Grocery as the predecessor. The site confirms an active community grocery store and café carrying quality groceries and locally sourced products; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
